title: Maintenance - slink.thecat.dev
lede_paragraph_1: Due to a PHP vulnerability rated CRITICAL, the Slink web interface has been taken offline as a precaution. Direct image links in the format /image/IMAGE_HASH.ext continue to be served. All other routes are disabled.
lede_paragraph_2: The PHP security update was released on 21.10.2026.
lede_paragraph_3: The Slink web interface will stay offline until the updated upstream image has been built, tested and deployed.
timer_note: Waiting for the updated Slink image. The interface will be re-enabled once it has been released and verified.
foot_text: Image hotlinks keep working. Uploads, login and the gallery are disabled.
